risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively detailed and quantified, but highlights substantial Electronics Group revenue pressure, uncertain defense spending, lack of near-term replacement programs, and potential impairment or restructuring charges. Management describes cost reductions and new product initiatives, yet acknowledges these may not offset further volume declines. Goodwill headroom of approximately 21% provides some cushion but depends on highly judgmental cash-flow, growth-rate, and discount-rate assumptions.
